svg.aria-label: How I build: I’m a designer who builds with AI. I design websites and mobile apps, then code, connect and publish them myself with tools like Claude Code and Codex. Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Visual Studio Code, Figma, Next.js, React, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, WordPress, Framer, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere, Pencil.
